propositions: Flaky tests should be debugged to root cause using /rebar-debug, not retried until they pass, because every recheck wastes tokens and erodes CI as a regression oracle.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md currently offer recheck as a valid response to failures that merely 'look transient/flaky', creating a license to retry rather than debug.

The rule must reserve recheck only for provably environmental faults (TLS/cert flakes, missing dispatch, runner outage) with reasoning stated in the comment, narrowing the existing guidance to eliminate self-contradiction.
CONTRIBUTING.md section 6 must split the two cases explicitly so environmental faults are recheckable while nondeterministic test failures point to the AGENTS.md rule.
A new test must pin both the presence of the new rule and the absence of the old retry-until-green licence, verifying the contradiction is eliminated.
